metadata.description: KN's personal marketplace for Claude Code plugins

plugins.name: godot-gdscript-patterns
plugins.description: Godot 4 GDScript patterns and automated testing - architecture rules (signals up/calls down, typed GDScript, Resource data), state machines, autoloads, pooling, components, scene management, save systems, plus GdUnit4 headless testing and smoke-run verification

plugins.name: create-pr
plugins.description: Create a pull request on GitHub with conventional commit-style titles

plugins.name: unity-gamedev-standards
plugins.description: Unity 6 game development standards and testing - project structure, C# conventions, MonoBehaviour patterns, UniTask async, performance optimization, MVC character design, plus Unity Test Framework EditMode/PlayMode testing in batchmode

plugins.name: playdate-gamedev
plugins.description: Playdate game development with C language - template-based project setup, VSCode build tasks, coding standards, API patterns, asset management, and performance optimization

plugins.name: kn-gamedev-workflow
plugins.description: Universal game development workflow - modular design documents, implementation plans, progress tracking for cross-AI context sharing, plus systematic game-bug debugging discipline

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Create new skills, improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, update or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, or benchmark skill performance with variance analysis.

plugins.name: 3d-asset-pipeline
plugins.description: Godot-first 6-stage 3D asset pipeline from concept art to mesh, rig, animation, import, and in-engine review loop using cloud APIs: gpt-image-2, Hunyuan 3D 3.1 via Replicate, and Meshy v5.
